scope: TG1 policy-server Python runtime selection and fail-fast processor verification only

observations.validated_runtime: The existing shared LaWAM Python environment uses torch 2.6.0+cu124 and transformers 5.2.0 and loads the same frozen qwen3_weights directory as Qwen3VLProcessor with a Qwen2Tokenizer child.

changes: Set STAR_VLA_PYTHON for TG1A and TG1B to the existing shared LaWAM environment.

For the normal arm only, preserve the empty root-owned feature directory left by runtime v3 under a failed_runtime_v3 suffix; refuse the operation if it contains any file or if a capture marker exists.
invariants: All frozen admission manifests, formal runners, model code, data, checkpoints, arms, seeds, task panels, optimizer settings, training steps, gates, and result selection remain unchanged.
TG2 training remains on runtime amendment v3 and its already submitted jobs are not modified.
Framework, mounts, renderer preparation, Git trust, and entrypoint audit logging remain unchanged from runtime amendment v3.
